title: MA61046: Multi
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite: Operations ResearchFormulation of multi-objective (linear and
non-linear programming) problems and related terms, dominated and nondominated solutions. Goal programming - Graphical method, sequential goal
programming method, multiphase simplex
method. Fuzzy programming, vector
maximum and vector minimum problems, linear and non-linear membership
functions, compromise solutions, utility function method, weighting method.
Analytic hierarchy process, ranking method, surrogate worth trade off method,
step method, e-constrained method, global criterion method, group decision
making. Applications of multi-objective programming to some real-world
problems.
